title: Slovakia Caught Between Austerity Demands and a Cost-of-Living Squeeze · 04 Sep
keywords: Slovakia, fiscal consolidation, public finances, austerity, inflation, cost of living, unemployment, eurozone, Bratislava, Eurostat, European Commission, labour market, deficit, debt sustainability
notes: Slovakia faces a deepening tension between the need to consolidate its public finances and the strain that rising prices and a softening labour market are placing on ordinary households. With the country's long-term fiscal sustainability rated as high-risk by European indicators, the government insists that spending restraint is unavoidable. Critics argue the burden is falling disproportionately on citizens rather than on structural reform.
